metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: Since you loved Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You, this witty, fast-paced high school comedy with a stellar lead performance will be right up your alley.

metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: An absolute classic of the teen comedy genre that matches the bright aesthetic, memorable quotes, and sharp humor of Clueless.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: A highly comforting, uplifting, and stylish comedy that mirrors the smart, fashionable, and underestimated heroine of Clueless.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: This whimsical fantasy adventure perfectly captures the magical, cozy charm of Practical Magic and the magical creature fun of Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: The ultimate comfort movie. It beautifully blends fantasy, romance, and witty comedy in a way that fans of Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves will adore.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A perfect blend of high-octane action, historical fantasy, and hilarious banter that will appeal to fans of Jumanji and Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
metas.description: An excellent sci-fi adventure with high stakes, a killer retro soundtrack, and snappy humor similar to Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Directed by Shane Black, this film matches the exact same buddy-cop, razor-sharp crime-comedy tone and banter of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: Since you are looking forward to Wake Up Dead Man, experience the star-studded whodunnit mystery that started the hilarious, clever franchise.

metas.name: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
metas.description: A perfect companion to your interest in Wake Up Dead Man, featuring luxurious settings, broad humor, and a stellar puzzle plot.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A highly energetic, hilarious, and fast-paced mystery-comedy that matches the chaotic energy and adult humor of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A joyful sci-fi action comedy with a gaming/fantasy element that fans of Jumanji and Pacific Rim will absolutely adore.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: High-octane action mixed with quirky characters and laugh-out-loud comedy, echoing the stylized, fast-paced energy of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Love and Monsters
metas.description: A charming, lighthearted post-apocalyptic adventure that matches the survival-comedy vibes and creature designs of Jumanji.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A delightful jungle treasure hunt adventure-comedy that perfectly mirrors the lighthearted, star-powered tone of Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle.

metas.name: Romancing the Stone
metas.description: A classic adventure-romance that served as a major inspiration for modern escapist comedies like Jumanji and Dungeons & Dragons.

metas.name: National Treasure
metas.description: Pure, unadulterated comfort action-adventure with high entertainment value, historical secrets, and a fun, lighthearted tone.

metas.name: Scott Pilgrim vs. the World
metas.description: A visually inventive, fast-paced comedy with video-game logic that matches the high-energy fun of Jumanji and the stylization of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Borat
metas.description: If you enjoyed the boundary-pushing, outrageous cringe-comedy and mockumentary style of Brüno, this is Sacha Baron Cohen's ultimate masterpiece.

metas.name: The Mask
metas.description: Fans of Jim Carrey's manic, physical comedy styling in Ace Ventura: Pet Detective will love this cartoonish, high-energy classic.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: A brilliant, action-packed movie industry satire that matches the outrageous, meta humor of Brüno and Get Shorty.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: An incredibly smart, action-packed buddy-cop parody that matches the high-energy crime-solving and hilarious partnership of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Shaun of the Dead
metas.description: A masterful horror-comedy that blends genuine laughs and thrills beautifully, fitting your love for fun, self-aware creature features like Anaconda.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A high-octane action-comedy with a great ensemble cast, delivering comfort, laughs, and creative monster-slaying akin to Jumanji.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A hilarious vampire mockumentary that brings the same witty, offbeat fantasy comedy elements found in Practical Magic.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: An upbeat, modern-styled medieval adventure full of charm, romance, and an amazing classic rock soundtrack, starring Heath Ledger from 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Summer Wars
metas.description: An energetic and heartwarming anime that combines family drama with high-stakes virtual reality action, perfect for fans of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
metas.description: A beautiful, hilarious, and heartwarming indie adventure directed by Taika Waititi, capturing the same quirky comedic soul as Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A brilliant Disney subversion that mixes whimsical fantasy, romance, and catchy music, perfect for fans of Practical Magic and Clueless.

metas.name: Logan Lucky
metas.description: A breezy, fun, and clever heist comedy with a stellar cast, perfect if you loved the cool crime vibes and dry humor of Get Shorty.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: A highly rewatchable, funny, and upbeat musical comedy that delivers major feel-good, comfort-movie vibes like Clueless.

metas.name: Crazy Rich Asians
metas.description: A lavish, colorful, and highly comforting romantic comedy that matches the modern-fairytale charm and bright aesthetic of Clueless.

metas.name: About Time
metas.description: A heartwarming rom-com with a subtle fantasy time-travel twist that matches the sweet, magical, and comforting tone of Practical Magic.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: A highly stylized, cartoonish, and ultra-fun spy movie that fits the high-octane fun profile of Thor: Ragnarok and Pacific Rim.

metas.name: Men in Black
metas.description: The ultimate sci-fi buddy-comedy that matches the high-energy creature fun of Fantastic Beasts and the hilarious investigative vibes of Ace Ventura.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of the funniest, most fast-paced animated comedies ever made, offering pure comfort, brilliant banter, and laugh-out-loud slapstick.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A hilarious action-comedy that subverts secret agent tropes with the same chaotic, laugh-out-loud energy as The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A beautifully whimsical, visually stunning, and highly romantic French comedy that fans of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl will fall in love with.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie that prioritizes heart, humor, and fun adventure over world-ending dread, perfect for fans of Jumanji and Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Yesterday
metas.description: A lighthearted, high-concept musical romantic comedy with a warm heart, fantastic music, and plenty of comforting charm.
